title: 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross is a carryover model, following a comprehensive update for the 2026 model year.
body_markdown:
The Corolla nameplate has come to define affordable and reliable transportation all around the world. Here in the United States we have several models that wear the Corolla badge, including the Corolla Cross—a crossover model that offers buyers more ground clearance, a higher seating position, and more space inside than the sedan or hatchback models.

## What’s New for the 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross


Toyota made several meaningful upgrades to the Corolla Cross in 2026, so it’s not surprising that it rolls into the 2027 model year without any significant changes. Last year’s bold new grille, restyled interior, and upgraded digital instrument cluster and infotainment screen remain on the menu. The 2027 Corolla Cross is offered in base L, LE, and XLE trim levels. In addition to the standard gasoline Corolla Cross we’re covering here, Toyota also offers the Corolla Cross Hybrid, **[which we cover separately](https://www.cargurus.com/research/articles/2027-toyota-corolla-cross-hybrid-pricing-specs-release-date)** .


## Design


The Corolla Cross shares a design theme that’s clearly related to the Corolla sedan, but with a much more rugged overall appearance. As such, it sits higher off the ground than the sedan and has chunky lower-body cladding. Premium elements such as LED lighting, two-tone paint options, and multiple wheel designs are available.


## Powertrain


All non-hybrid Corolla Cross models use the same 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine that produces 169 horsepower and 150 pound-feet of torque. That’s not a ton of power, but it’s adequate, and the continuously variable automatic transmission (CVT) with a separate first gear ratio helps the Corolla Cross feel a bit more responsive when accelerating from a standstill. Front-wheel drive (FWD) is standard, with all-wheel drive (AWD) available as an option. The 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross is estimated to return 30 mpg in the city, 32 mpg on the highway, and 31 mpg combined in FWD form. Opting for AWD drops those figures slightly to 29 mpg city, 31 mpg highway, and 30 mpg combined. The 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross can tow up to 1,500 pounds.


## Interior


The interior of the Corolla Cross is straightforward and crafted with materials that feel high-quality considering its low starting price. The base L trim includes cloth upholstery in light gray, while the LE offers the addition of black cloth. The XLE model gets SofTex synthetic leather upholstery in either brown or black. The Corolla Cross is roomier than the Corolla sedan, particularly in the back where there’s 2.1 inches of additional legroom and an extra 1.4 inches of headroom. There’s up to 24 cubic feet of storage space (or 21.5 cubic feet with AWD) with the split-folding rear seat in place, or up to 46.9 cubic feet (44 cubic feet with AWD) with the back seat folded flat. That’s more space than the Corolla Hatchback, but less than many competitors.


## Technology


Toyota Corolla Cross L and LE models come standard with a 7-inch digital gauge cluster and an 8-inch touchscreen infotainment screen. XLE models have a 12.3-inch digital gauge cluster and a 10.5-inch infotainment screen. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity are standard, while LE and XLE models get a wireless device charger. A six-speaker audio system comes standard in all Corolla Cross models, and a nine-speaker JBL system is an option for XLE models. Toyota’s Remote Connect, which requires a trial or subscription, works with a smartphone or smartwatch app to allow owners to do things such as lock and unlock the vehicle, remotely start it, or find its location. Drive Connect, which also requires a trial or subscription, adds Cloud Navigation, Google Points of Interest, Toyota’s voice-activated Intelligent Assistant, and more.

## Safety


The Corolla Cross comes standard with Toyota Safety Sense 3.0, a driver-assistance package that includes adaptive cruise control, automatic emergency braking, lane-departure alert, lane-keep assist, traffic-sign assist, and high-beam assist. A blind-spot monitor and rear cross-traffic alert are standard with the LE trim and above. Although the 2027 Corolla Cross had not been crash-tested at the time of writing, the 2025 model was awarded a Top Safety Pick designation from the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety. It also received a maximum five-star overall safety rating from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.


## Pricing and Release Date


At the time of writing, the 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross carried an MSRP of $27,130 (including destination) in base L trim with FWD. The LE model starts at $29,460 and the XLE at $32,055. AWD adds $1,300 to the price of the L and LE models, or $1,450 to the XLE.
